title: $10B private placement of shares to Berkshire Hathaway
detail: Securities purchase agreement of 2026-06-01: 14,212,035 Class A shares at about $351.81 and 14,359,656 Class C shares at about $348.20, sold to an affiliate of Berkshire Hathaway under Section 4(a)(2), alongside the public share and mandatory convertible preferred offerings

title: $850.0M 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032 (private offering, priced)
detail: Initial purchasers hold a 13-day option for up to an additional $150.0 million of notes; concurrently Cipher expects to exchange approximately $165.9 million principal amount of its convertible senior notes due 2030 in privately negotiated transactions.

title: S&P Global Ratings upgrades long-term issuer credit rating to BBB (outlook Positive)
detail: Long-term issuer credit rating from S&P Global Ratings upgraded to BBB; outlook Positive.

title: $700M short-term credit facility from IDB Invest (approved in August 2026)
detail: POSCO HOLDINGS' 10-14-2026 release on its second Argentina brine lithium plant states that in August it secured approval for a $700 million short-term credit facility from IDB Invest (Inter-American Investment Corporation); the exact approval day is not stated, so the row is dated the disclosing release.

title: Westinghouse (a Brookfield Renewable sustainable-solutions investment) confidentially submitted a draft registration statement to the SEC for a proposed IPO
detail: Brookfield Renewable's Q2 2026 interim report (6-K, 07-31-2026): the number of shares to be offered and the price range had not been determined; the proposed offering is subject to market and other conditions. Recorded here, not on the map (board question 61, 2026-10-19: IPO / listing filings are financing).

title: Conditional commitment letter: up to $1.5B senior secured delayed-draw term loan from the U.S. Department of War (Office of Strategic Capital)
detail: Conditional commitment letter (not a definitive agreement): up to four tranches - $600 million initial tranche (to refinance in full the first lien senior secured notes due 2030 and pay fees, subject to a Project Undertaking) and $900 million remaining tranches of $200-400 million; expected 30-year maturity and 36-month commitment period; rate expected at the comparable U.S. Treasury rate plus a risk premium provisionally 1.25%-1.75%; subject to due diligence, definitive agreements, congressional authorizations / appropriations, OMB concurrence, equitizing a substantial majority of the convertible notes and offtake letters of intent or agreements.
added_by: 2026-10-19 board decision (user-delegated), question Wolfspeed: financing kept out of the map, recorded here per skill section 10c

title: Underwritten public offering of 61,540,000 Class A shares (~$200M gross)
detail: Underwriting agreement for 61,540,000 shares of Class A common stock at $3.25 per share; gross proceeds expected ~$200 million before underwriting discounts and expenses; expected to close 10-16-2026 (8-K Item 1.01 / 8.01).

title: Unsecured demand grid promissory note: up to $100M line of credit from Applied Digital
detail: Unsecured Demand Grid Promissory Note with Applied Digital Corporation (parent, ~96% owner): line of credit up to $100,000,000 minus any credit support provided by the lender or its affiliates; prepayable at any time without penalty (8-K Item 1.01).

title: Department of War anchor investment in the Missile Solutions (MSL) business: $1.0B convertible preferred security
detail: On January 13, 2026 L3Harris announced a strategic investment by the DoW in its MSL business: the DoW agreed to be the anchor investor through a $1.0 billion convertible preferred security, anticipated to convert automatically into common equity upon the completion of an IPO of the MSL business (10-K, filed 02-12-2026).

title: Series E: $1.5B at a $6.2B post-money valuation
detail: Tenstorrent has closed $1.5B in Series E funding at a $6.2B post-money valuation; the round was led by Trace Capital and Innovation X with participation from new and existing investors (company release).

title: Strategic investment led by Siemens (amount not stated)
detail: Skeleton Technologies secured a strategic investment led by Siemens to expand US manufacturing; it plans to invest more than $200 million in operational scale-up and R&D in Silicon Valley (company release; the investment amount is not stated).

title: Expected equity needs of roughly $12-17 billion through 2032 (reiterated)
detail: CFO Mike Dunne on the Q3 2026 call: expected equity issuances remain consistent with the range provided of roughly $12 billion-$17 billion of total equity needs through 2032.

title: Secured capacity to borrow up to $30 billion
detail: Q3 2026 call: during the quarter Tesla secured capacity to borrow up to $30 billion to support the expected capital deployment (2026 capex guidance revised to approximately $20 billion, funded primarily from operating cash flows).

title: At-The-Market equity offering completed: ~$1.944B gross proceeds (29.3M shares) to fund the Iridium acquisition
detail: Rocket Lab completed its ATM program, raising approximately $1.944 billion in gross proceeds through the issuance of 29.3 million shares, to fund cash payments under the pending Iridium acquisition (expected to close mid-2027).

title: Iridium's existing $1.775B credit facility amended to permit the change of control (Rocket Lab USA parent guarantee)
detail: Iridium amends its existing $1.775 billion credit facility to permit the change of control, as permanent financing backed by a parent guarantee from Rocket Lab USA.

title: Initial $3.6B senior secured bridge facility for the Iridium acquisition cancelled
detail: Rocket Lab cancelled the initial $3.6B senior secured bridge facility after fully financing the Iridium acquisition.

title: Upsized IPO closed: 28,000,000 Class A shares at $60.00 (Nasdaq: QNT)
detail: Quantinuum closed its upsized initial public offering of 28,000,000 shares of Class A common stock at $60.00 per share (registration statement effective June 3, 2026); gross proceeds before underwriting discounts, commissions and other offering expenses were $1.68 billion (company release).

title: IPO closed (last week of April 2026): about $1.1 billion of net proceeds
detail: CFO Daniel Gross on the Q2 2026 call: X-Energy closed its IPO in the last week of April 2026; liquidity roughly doubled thanks to the $1.1 billion of net IPO proceeds (cash and investments about $1.9 billion, zero debt).

title: Amendment No. 3 to Credit Agreement: $70 million incremental revolving commitments (total up to $200 million)
detail: On October 16, 2026 MaxLinear entered into Amendment No. 3 to its June 23, 2021 Credit Agreement (Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. as administrative and collateral agent): $70 million of incremental revolving credit commitments, taking the senior secured revolving facility to total commitments of up to $200 million; the liquidity covenant threshold was reduced from $80 million to $60 million (8-K Item 1.01, filed 10-22-2026).

title: Partial prepayment of $1.5 billion on the 2025 term loan due 2027 ($1.25 billion outstanding at September 30, 2026)
detail: Honeywell 10-Q (10-22-2026): 'In August 2026, the Company made a partial prepayment of $1.5 billion on the $2.75 billion of borrowings outstanding under the 2025 term loan due 2027. As of September 30, 2026, there were $1.25 billion of borrowings outstanding under this term loan.' (date = August 2026; the day is not stated, month-end used).

title: JCET board approves private A-share placement to specific investors
detail: Board (9th board, 5th extraordinary meeting) approved issuing A shares to no more than 35 specific investors including the controlling shareholder; not more than 12,787.7237 ten-thousand shares; proceeds for HPC high-end advanced packaging platform expansion, high-end power-module packaging capacity upgrade, wafer-level packaging platform upgrade, high-density memory SiP capability upgrade, working capital and bank-loan repayment. State-owned-asset approval obtained in principle; still needs shareholder approval, SSE review and CSRC registration (status per the 2026 Q3 report). Amount as stated: not more than RMB 65 hundred million.

title: Shennan Circuits 2026 private placement passes SZSE listing review center
detail: Placement to no more than 35 specific investors, proceeds (after fees) for the Wuxi Shennan Circuits AI compute electronic circuit products project and working capital; board approved 2026-06-12, state-owned-asset approval disclosed 2026-07-09, shareholders approved 2026-08-14, amount cut 2026-09-08, SZSE listing review center approval 2026-10-14 (per the 2026 Q3 report). Amount as stated: RMB 436,735.20 ten-thousand (reduced from RMB 488,196.88 ten-thousand on 2026-09-08).

title: Range Intelligent Computing medium-term notes issued in the interbank market (bonds payable at 2026-09-30)
detail: The Q3 report says bonds payable of RMB 994,631,400.41 (none at end-2025) are mainly from medium-term notes issued in the interbank market during the period; long-term borrowings rose 42.43% to RMB 18,719,334,800.00 and long-term payables 65.48% to RMB 7,313,689,979.40 as financing grew with compute-equipment investment. Issue date not stated; dated the report's disclosure day. Amount as stated: bonds payable RMB 994,631,400.41 at 2026-09-30.

title: Neuberger Specialty Finance (NBSF) $700 million facility to finance power infrastructure for Crusoe's AI factories
detail: Facility secured by recently ordered power generation equipment; funds gas generators providing behind-the-meter power to Crusoe-built and Crusoe-owned AI factories. The release also restates the September 2026 close of a $3.9 billion Series F at a $30.9 billion post-money valuation. Amount as stated: $700 million.

title: QumulusAI expands closed equipment lease financing with Tech Finance Co. (TFC) to approximately $123.6 million
detail: Three-year leases funding NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs bought in May and July 2026; TFC financed 85% to 90% of equipment cost per schedule, customer deposits the balance; no new equity; implied high single-digit annualized interest rate; end-of-term buy or return options. Amount as stated: approximately $123.6 million (up from $26.0 million announced May 7, 2026).
